title: Room home changed
description: A pod adopted a room another pod was serving: the room moved, it did not end. Published by the NEW home, so the event's `source` names it — follow this rather than the departures on the old side, because a pod that loses a room by being deleted publishes nothing at all. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.room.home_changed` CloudEvent.

previousPod.description: The pod that held the home lease before this one, as the Room record named it. Absent when the lease was already released or the record is gone.
